.dh-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem}
.ctx-pill{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:.25rem .7rem;background:var(--panel2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.chev{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
.drawer.open .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.drawer-body{
  display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;
  transition:grid-template-rows .4s var(--ease);
}
.drawer.open .drawer-body{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.drawer-inner{overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.drawer-pad{padding:0 1.3rem 1.4rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:1.2rem}
.field-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1rem 1.2rem}
.field-grid .span2{grid-column:span 2}
@media (max-width:720px){.field-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.field-grid .span2{grid-column:auto}}
.field label{display:block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.45rem}
.inp{
  width:100%;
  background:var(--panel2);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.85rem;
  padding:.65rem .85rem;
  transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.inp:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent)}
.inp::placeholder{color:var(--faint)}
.keywrap{position:relative}
.keywrap .inp{padding-right:2.6rem;font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.eye{
  position:absolute;right:.5rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  background:none;border:none;color:var(--faint);cursor:pointer;padding:.3rem;display:flex;
}
.eye:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.range-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;flex:1;height:5px;border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent) var(--fill,40%),var(--line-strong) var(--fill,40%));
  cursor:pointer;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--accent);border:3px solid var(--panel);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);cursor:grab;
}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);border:3px solid var(--panel);cursor:grab;
}
.range-val{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--accent);min-width:3.2ch;text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.settings-foot{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-top:1.2rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
}
.settings-note{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);max-width:64ch}
.settings-note b{color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- Results ---------- */
.results{margin:1.6rem 0 2.6rem}
.res-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.res-head h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:700;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.res-head .res-sub{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.2rem}
.status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;min-height:1.4em}
.status .sdot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--faint);flex:none}
.status.run .sdot{background:var(--accent);animation:pulse 1.4s infinite}
.status.ok{color:var(--accent)}
.status.ok .sdot{background:var(--accent)}
.status.err{color:var(--danger)}
.status.err .sdot{background:var(--danger)}
.status .smsg{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.status.err .smsg{color:var(--danger);max-width:70ch}

.tabs{display:flex;gap:.35rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:0}
.tab{
  position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:.65rem 1rem;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:color .2s, background .2s;
}
.tab:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--panel2)}
.tab.active{color:var(--accent)}
.tab.active::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border-radius:2px;
}
.tab .n{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
  background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;padding:.05rem .5rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.tab.active .n{color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 40%,transparent)}
.tab .tn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint)}

.pane{display:none}
.pane.active{display:block;animation:fadeUp .35s var(--ease)}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.pane-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.pane-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;min-width:0}
.pane-title .pt{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.pane-title .pw{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pane-actions{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pane-actions .mini-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}

.empty{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;
  padding:3.2rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);
  border:1px dashed var(--line-strong);border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--panel2);
  min-height:220px;
}
.empty svg{width:34px;height:34px;opacity:.6}
.empty .et{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.empty .es{font-size:.8rem;max-width:44ch}

/* ---------- Paper (resume / cover letter) ---------- */
.paper{
  background:var(--paper);
  color:#242b36;
  border:1px solid var(--paper-line);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.6rem);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6;
  max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;
}
.paper h1{font-size:1.5rem;margin:0 0 1rem;color:#111827;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-weight:700}
.paper h2{
  font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;
  color:#0c6b4d;font-weight:700;margin:1.3rem 0 .55rem;
  padding-bottom:.3rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-line);
}
.paper p{margin:.45rem 0}
.paper ul{margin:.4rem 0 .6rem;padding-left:1.15rem}
.paper li{margin:.28rem 0;padding-left:.2rem}
.paper li::marker{color:#0c6b4d}
.paper .mono{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.82rem}
.paper .stream-caret{display:inline-block;width:.55em;height:1.05em;background:var(--accent);vertical-align:-.18em;margin-left:2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite;border-radius:2px}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}

/* ---------- Q&A accordion ---------- */
.qa-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.qa{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;
  overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .2s;
}
.qa:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.qa-q{
  width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.8rem;text-align:left;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);
  padding:.85rem 1rem;font-family:var(--font-body);
}
.qa-q .qnum{
  flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:.1rem;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent);
  color:var(--accent);font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}
.qa-q .qt{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;flex:1}
.qa-q .qchev{flex:none;width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:.25rem;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
.qa.open .qchev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.qa-a{
  display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease);
}
.qa.open .qa-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.qa-a-in{overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.qa-a-in .qa-body{
  padding:0 1rem 1rem 3.2rem;
  font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;
  white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;
}
.qa-a-in .qa-body strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */
.toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  color:var(--text);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:.65rem 1.2rem;border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:100;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s var(--ease);
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:1rem;padding:1.4rem 0 2.2rem}
footer .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.f-note{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);max-width:70ch}
.f-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint)}
.f-brand svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--accent)}

/* ---------- Utilities / motion ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .brand-sub{display:none}
  .actionbar{justify-content:center}
  .ab-left{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .ab-right{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
  .qa-a-in .qa-body{padding-left:1rem}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ======================= Header ======================= -->
<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="mark" aria-hidden="true">C</div>
      <div class="brand-txt">
        <span class="brand-name">Crafted</span>
        <span class="brand-sub">Resume Customizer · AI Studio</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="top-actions">
      <button class="icon-btn" id="btnTheme" type="button" aria-label="Switch theme">
        <svg id="icoSun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2m0 16v2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4m11.4 11.4 1.4 1.4M2 12h2m16 0h2M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4m11.4-11.4 1.4-1.4"/></svg>
        <svg id="icoMoon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="display:none"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8z"/></svg>
        <span id="themeLabel">Light</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ======================= Hero ======================= -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker"><span class="dot"></span>OpenAI-compatible · Local-first</span>
    <h1>Craft a resume that <span class="grad">fits the job.</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">Paste your complete super resume and the target job description. Crafted asks your model for an ATS-ready one-page resume, a matching cover letter, and 30 interview questions with answers — streamed live, right in your browser.</p>
    <div class="chips">
      <span class="chip"><b>01</b> ATS-ready one-page resume</span>
      <span class="chip"><b>02</b> Tailored cover letter</span>
      <span class="chip"><b>03</b> 30 interview Q&As</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ======================= Inputs ======================= -->
<main class="wrap">
  <section class="inputs">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-head">
        <div>
          <span class="step">Step 1</span>
          <h2>Super Resume</h2>
          <p class="hint">Your complete resume — every role, skill and detail. The model will distill and tailor it.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card-tools">
          <button class="mini-btn" id="btnCopyResume" type="button">Copy</button>
          <button class="mini-btn" id="btnRestore" type="button">Restore sample</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <textarea id="resume" placeholder="Paste your complete resume here…" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
      <div class="card-foot">
        <span class="counter" id="resumeCount">0 words</span>
        <span class="badge-warn" id="resumeWarn">Required</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-head">
        <div>
          <span class="step">Step 2</span>
          <h2>Job Description</h2>
          <p class="hint">The full posting for the role you're targeting — responsibilities, requirements and everything else.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card-tools">
          <button class="mini-btn" id="btnCopyJob" type="button">Copy</button>
          <button class="mini-btn" id="btnClearJob" type="button">Clear</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <textarea id="job" placeholder="Paste the job description here…" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
      <div class="card-foot">
        <span class="counter" id="jobCount">0 words</span>
        <span class="badge-warn" id="jobWarn">Required</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ======================= Action bar ======================= -->
  <section class="card actionbar">
    <div class="ab-left">
      <span class="model-chip">
        <span class="mdot" id="modelDot"></span>
        <span>Model</span>
        <code id="modelChip">Local model</code>
      </span>
      <span class="prompt-est" id="promptEst">~0 tokens · context 65,536</span>
    </div>
    <div class="ab-right">
      <button class="btn-ghost" id="btnCopyPrompt" type="button" title="Copy the exact prompt sent to the model">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10"/></svg>
        Copy prompt
      </button>
      <button class="btn-danger" id="btnStop" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>
        Stop
      </button>
      <button class="btn-primary" id="btnGenerate" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 3l1.9 5.6L19.5 10.5l-5.6 1.9L12 18l-1.9-5.6L4.5 10.5l5.6-1.9z"/><path d="M19 15l.8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8z"/></svg>
        Generate
      </button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ======================= Settings ======================= -->
  <section class="card drawer" id="drawer">
    <button class="drawer-head" id="drawerHead" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="drawerBody">
      <span class="dh-left">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34 1.87l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.87-.34 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1 1.55V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1-1.55 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.87.34l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34-1.87 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.55-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.55-1 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34-1.87l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.87.34h.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1-1.55V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1 1.55 1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.87-.34l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34 1.87v.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.55 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.55 1z"/></svg>
        <span class="dh-title">API Settings</span>
        <span class="dh-sub" id="endpointShort">localhost</span>
      </span>
      <span class="dh-right">
        <span class="ctx-pill" id="ctxPill">65,536 context</span>
        <svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
      </span>
    </button>
    <div class="drawer-body" id="drawerBody">
      <div class="drawer-inner">
        <div class="drawer-pad">
          <div class="field-grid">
            <div class="field span2">
              <label for="fEndpoint">Endpoint (OpenAI-compatible /v1)</label>
              <input class="inp" id="fEndpoint" type="text" placeholder="http://localhost:1234/v1" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off">
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fKey">API Key</label>
              <div class="keywrap">
                <input class="inp" id="fKey" type="password" placeholder="apiKey" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off">
                <button class="eye" id="btnKey" type="button" aria-label="Show or hide API key">
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fModel">Model</label>
              <input class="inp" id="fModel" type="text" placeholder="Local model" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off">
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fCtx">Context window (tokens)</label>
              <input class="inp" id="fCtx" type="number" min="2000" step="1000" placeholder="65536">
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fTemp">Temperature</label>
              <div class="range-row">
                <input type="range" id="fTemp" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="0.4">
                <span class="range-val" id="tempVal">0.40</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="settings-foot">
            <p class="settings-note"><b>Local-first:</b> your resume, job description and generated output are sent only to the endpoint you configure. Nothing is uploaded elsewhere — and if the endpoint is <b>localhost</b>, everything stays on your machine. Settings and drafts are stored in your browser.</p>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnDefaults" type="button">Reset to defaults</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ======================= Results ======================= -->
  <section class="results">
    <div class="res-head">
      <div>
        <h2>Your Package</h2>
        <div class="res-sub">Generated in one pass — resume, cover letter and interview prep.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="status" id="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span class="sdot"></span>
        <span class="smsg">Ready when you are.</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:1.1rem 1.1rem 1.3rem">
      <div class="tabs" role="tablist">
        <button class="tab active" id="tabResume" type="button" role="tab" data-pane="paneResume">
          <span class="tn">01</span> Resume <span class="n" id="cntResume">0w</span>
        </button>
        <button class="tab" id="tabLetter" type="button" role="tab" data-pane="paneLetter">
          <span class="tn">02</span> Cover Letter <span class="n" id="cntLetter">0w</span>
        </button>
        <button class="tab" id="tabQa" type="button" role="tab" data-pane="paneQa">
          <span class="tn">03</span> Interview Q&A <span class="n" id="cntQa">0</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- Resume pane -->
      <div class="pane active" id="paneResume" role="tabpanel">
        <div class="pane-bar">
          <div class="pane-title"><span class="pt">ATS-Ready Resume</span><span class="pw" id="pwResume"></span></div>
          <div class="pane-actions">
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnCopyResumeOut" type="button" disabled>Copy</button>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnDownloadResume" type="button" disabled>Download .txt</button>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnPrintResume" type="button" disabled>Print / PDF</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="outResume" class="out"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- Cover letter pane -->
      <div class="pane" id="paneLetter" role="tabpanel">
        <div class="pane-bar">
          <div class="pane-title"><span class="pt">Cover Letter</span><span class="pw" id="pwLetter"></span></div>
          <div class="pane-actions">
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnCopyLetter" type="button" disabled>Copy</button>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnDownloadLetter" type="button" disabled>Download .txt</button>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnPrintLetter" type="button" disabled>Print / PDF</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="outLetter" class="out"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- Q&A pane -->
      <div class="pane" id="paneQa" role="tabpanel">
        <div class="pane-bar">
          <div class="pane-title"><span class="pt">Interview Q&A</span><span class="pw" id="pwQa"></span></div>
          <div class="pane-actions">
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnCopyQa" type="button" disabled>Copy</button>
            <button class="mini-btn" id="btnDownloadQa" type="button" disabled>Download .txt</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="outQa" class="out"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

/* ---------------- Clipboard / download / print ---------------- */
async function copyText(text, label){
  try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
  catch(e){
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.opacity='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
    catch(e2){ toast('Copy failed — select the text manually'); }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}
function downloadText(filename, text){
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url; a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 400);
  toast('Downloading ' + filename);
}

/* ---------------- Text helpers ---------------- */
function wordsOf(t){ const s=(t||'').trim(); return s ? s.split(/\s+/).length : 0; }
function fmt(n){ return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function escHtml(s){ return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>'); }

/* Minimal plain-text → HTML for the "paper" views */
function plainToHtml(text){
  const lines = escHtml(text||'').split('\n');
  let html = '', inList = false;
  const closeList = () => { if(inList){ html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const line = raw.trimEnd();
    const t = line.trim();
    if(!t){ closeList(); continue; }
    if(/^#{1,2}\s+/.test(t)){ closeList(); const lvl = t.startsWith('##') ? 2 : 1; html += '<h'+lvl+'>'+t.replace(/^#{1,2}\s+/,'')+'</h'+lvl+'>'; }
    else if(/^[-*•]\s+/.test(t)){ if(!inList){ html += '<ul>'; inList = true; } html += '<li>'+t.replace(/^[-*•]\s+/,'')+'</li>'; }
    else { closeList(); html += '<p>'+t+'</p>'; }
  }
  closeList();
  return html;
}

/* ---------------- Section parsing ---------------- */
function parseSections(full){
  const lines = (full||'').split('\n');
  let cover = -1, qa = -1;
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    if(!t) continue;
    const isCover = /\bcover letter\b/i.test(t) && t.length < 90 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    const isQa = /\binterview\b/i.test(t) && /\bquestion/i.test(t) && t.length < 100 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    if(cover < 0 && isCover){ cover = i; continue; }
    if(cover >= 0 && qa < 0 && isQa){ qa = i; break; }
  }
  if(cover < 0) cover = lines.length;
  if(qa < 0 || qa <= cover) qa = lines.length;
  const clean = s => s.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  return {
    resume: clean(lines.slice(0, cover).join('\n')),
    cover: clean(lines.slice(cover+1, qa).join('\n')),
    qa: clean(lines.slice(qa+1).join('\n'))
  };
}
function parseQa(text){
  const items = [];
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n');
  let cur = null;
  const flush = () => { if(cur){ items.push(cur); cur = null; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const t = raw.trim();
    const m = t.match(/^(?:Q\s*\d+\s*[:.)\-]?\s*|\d{1,2}\s*[.):\-]\s+|Question\s*\d+\s*:?\s+)(.*)$/i);
    if(m && m[1].length > 2){ flush(); cur = { q:m[1].trim(), a:'' }; continue; }
    if(/^(?:answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t) && !cur){ continue; }
    if(!cur){
      if(t.length < 130 && !/[.!?]$/.test(t) && (/\?$/.test(t) || /^(?:what|why|how|where|when|tell|describe|give|explain|walk|what's)/i.test(t))){
        cur = { q:t, a:'' };
      } else continue;
    } else if(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t)){
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t.replace(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]\s*/i,'');
    } else {
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t;
    }
  }
  flush();
  return items.map(x => ({ q:x.q, a:x.a.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() }));
}
function paperTitle(text){
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
  for(const l of lines){
    if(l.length < 4 || l.length > 45) continue;
    if(/^https?:|^mailto:|\+?[\d\s().-]{9,}$/.test(l)) continue;
    if(/[^A-Za-z .'-]/.test(l)) continue;
    const words = l.split(/\s+/);
    if(words.length < 2 || words.length > 5) continue;
    if(!words[0][0] || /[a-z]/.test(words[0][0])) continue;
    return l;
  }
  return 'Resume';
}

      '</button><div class="qa-a"><div class="qa-a-in"><div class="qa-body">'+escHtml(it.a || '—')+'</div></div></div></div>'
    ).join('') + '</div>';
  } else if(sections.qa){
    $('#outQa').innerHTML = '<div class="paper" style="max-width:860px">'+plainToHtml(sections.qa)+caret+'</div>';
  } else {
    $('#outQa').innerHTML = EMPTY_HTML(ICON_QA, '30 interview Q&As appear here', 'Questions and potential answers for the role.');
  }
  /* counters + action availability */
  $('#cntResume').textContent = fmt(wordsOf(sections.resume)) + 'w';
  $('#cntLetter').textContent = fmt(wordsOf(sections.cover)) + 'w';
  $('#cntQa').textContent = sections.qa ? currentQa.length : 0;
  $('#pwResume').textContent = sections.resume ? fmt(wordsOf(sections.resume)) + ' words' : '';
  $('#pwLetter').textContent = sections.cover ? fmt(wordsOf(sections.cover)) + ' words' : '';
  $('#pwQa').textContent = sections.qa ? (currentQa.length + (currentQa.length===1?' question':' questions') + ' · click to expand') : '';
  const has = { r:!!sections.resume, c:!!sections.cover, q:!!sections.qa };
  ['#btnCopyResumeOut','#btnDownloadResume','#btnPrintResume'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.r);
  ['#btnCopyLetter','#btnDownloadLetter','#btnPrintLetter'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.c);
  ['#btnCopyQa','#btnDownloadQa'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.q);
  if(opts.caret) switchTab('paneResume');
}

/* ---------------- Streaming ---------------- */

function readStream(reader, push, onErr, onDone){
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  return (async () => {
    while(true){
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if(done) break;
      buf += dec.decode(value, { stream:true });
      let nl;
      while((nl = buf.indexOf('\n')) !== -1){
        const line = buf.slice(0, nl).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
        buf = buf.slice(nl + 1);
        if(!line || !line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
        const data = line.slice(5).trim();
        if(data === '[DONE]') return onDone(true);
        try{
          const j = JSON.parse(data);
          const d = j.choices && j.choices[0] && (j.choices[0].delta || j.choices[0].message);
          const t = d && (d.content != null ? d.content : (d && d.content_parts ? d.content_parts.join('') : null));
          if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
        }catch(e){ /* partial line — ignore */ }
      }
    }
    onDone(false);
  })();
}
function nonStream(json, push){
  const c = json.choices && json.choices[0] && json.choices[0].message;
  const t = c && c.content;
  if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
}

async function callModel(prompt, signal){
  const url = (settings.endpoint || '').trim();
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method:'POST',
    signal,
    headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'Authorization':'Bearer ' + (settings.key || '') },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: settings.model || 'Local model',
      stream: true,
      temperature: settings.temp,
      max_tokens: Math.max(256, Math.floor((settings.ctx || 65536) * 0.7)),
      messages: [{ role:'user', content: prompt }]
    })
  });
  if(!res.ok){
    let msg = 'HTTP ' + res.status;
    try{ const j = await res.json(); msg = (j.error && j.error.message) || j.error || j.message || msg; if(typeof msg !== 'string') msg = JSON.stringify(msg); }catch(e){}
    throw new Error(msg + ' — ' + url);
  }
  const ctype = (res.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
  if(ctype.indexOf('json') !== -1){
    const json = await res.json();
    nonStream(json, pushChunk);
    return;
  }
  await readStream(res.body.getReader(), pushChunk, null, () => {});
}

async function generate(){
  const prompt = buildPrompt();
  if(!elResume.value.trim() || !elJob.value.trim()) return;
  running = true; liveFull = ''; lastSections = {resume:'',cover:'',qa:''};
  btnGenerate.disabled = true; btnStop.classList.add('show');
  abortCtrl = new AbortController();
  setStatus('run', 'Generating — streaming from ' + (settings.model || 'Local model') + '…');
  renderOutput({resume:'',cover:'',qa:''}, { caret:true });
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try{
    await callModel(prompt, abortCtrl.signal);
    stopLive();
    const secs = ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1);
    const s = parseSections(liveFull);
    lastSections = s;
    if(!liveFull.trim()){
      setStatus('err', 'The model returned an empty response.');
    } else {
      setStatus('ok', 'Done in ' + secs + 's · ' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' characters · ' + (currentQa.length || 30) + ' Q&As detected');
      renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
    }
  }catch(err){
    stopLive();
    const aborted = (err && err.name === 'AbortError');
    if(aborted){
      const s = parseSections(liveFull);
      lastSections = s;
      if(liveFull.trim()){
        renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
        setStatus('ok', 'Stopped by you — partial output kept (' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' chars).');
      } else {
        resetOutput();
        setStatus('', 'Stopped before anything was generated.');
      }
    } else {
      resetOutput();
      let msg = (err && err.message) || 'Request failed';
      if(/failed to fetch|networkerror|load failed|fetch/i.test(msg)){
        msg = 'Could not reach ' + (settings.endpoint||'the endpoint') + '. Is the server running? Check the endpoint, API key and model in Settings — and the browser console for CORS details.';
      }
      setStatus('err', msg);
    }
  }finally{
    running = false; abortCtrl = null;
    btnStop.classList.remove('show');
    refreshCounters();
  }
}

btnGenerate.addEventListener('click', generate);
btnStop.addEventListener('click', () => { if(abortCtrl) abortCtrl.abort(); });

/* ---------------- Init ---------------- */
(function init(){
  const draft = loadDraft();
  elResume.value = draft ? (draft.r != null ? draft.r : SAMPLE_RESUME) : SAMPLE_RESUME;
  elJob.value = draft ? (draft.j != null ? draft.j : '') : '';
  refreshSettingsUI();
  resetOutput();
  refreshCounters();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

.status.run .sdot{background:var(--accent);animation:pulse 1.4s infinite}
.status.ok{color:var(--accent)}
.status.ok .sdot{background:var(--accent)}
.status.err{color:var(--danger)}
.status.err .sdot{background:var(--danger)}
.status .smsg{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.status.err .smsg{color:var(--danger);max-width:70ch}

.tabs{display:flex;gap:.35rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:0}
.tab{
  position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:.65rem 1rem;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:color .2s, background .2s;
}
.tab:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--panel2)}
.tab.active{color:var(--accent)}
.tab.active::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border-radius:2px;
}
.tab .n{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
  background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;padding:.05rem .5rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.tab.active .n{color:var(--accent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 40%,transparent)}
.tab .tn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint)}

.pane{display:none}
.pane.active{display:block;animation:fadeUp .35s var(--ease)}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.pane-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.pane-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;min-width:0}
.pane-title .pt{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.pane-title .pw{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pane-actions{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pane-actions .mini-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}

.empty{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;
  padding:3.2rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);
  border:1px dashed var(--line-strong);border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--panel2);
  min-height:220px;
}
.empty svg{width:34px;height:34px;opacity:.6}
.empty .et{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.empty .es{font-size:.8rem;max-width:44ch}

/* ---------- Paper (resume / cover letter) ---------- */
.paper{
  background:var(--paper);
  color:#242b36;
  border:1px solid var(--paper-line);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.6rem);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6;
  max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;
}
.paper h1{font-size:1.5rem;margin:0 0 1rem;color:#111827;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-weight:700}
.paper h2{
  font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;
  color:#0c6b4d;font-weight:700;margin:1.3rem 0 .55rem;
  padding-bottom:.3rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-line);
}
.paper p{margin:.45rem 0}
.paper ul{margin:.4rem 0 .6rem;padding-left:1.15rem}
.paper li{margin:.28rem 0;padding-left:.2rem}
.paper li::marker{color:#0c6b4d}
.paper .mono{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.82rem}
.paper .stream-caret{display:inline-block;width:.55em;height:1.05em;background:var(--accent);vertical-align:-.18em;margin-left:2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite;border-radius:2px}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}

/* ---------- Q&A accordion ---------- */
.qa-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.qa{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;
  overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .2s;
}
.qa:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.qa-q{
  width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.8rem;text-align:left;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);
  padding:.85rem 1rem;font-family:var(--font-body);
}
.qa-q .qnum{
  flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:.1rem;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent);
  color:var(--accent);font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}
.qa-q .qt{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;flex:1}
.qa-q .qchev{flex:none;width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:.25rem;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
.qa.open .qchev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.qa-a{
  display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease);
}
.qa.open .qa-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.qa-a-in{overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.qa-a-in .qa-body{
  padding:0 1rem 1rem 3.2rem;
  font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;
  white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;
}
.qa-a-in .qa-body strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */
.toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  color:var(--text);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:.65rem 1.2rem;border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:100;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s var(--ease);
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:1rem;padding:1.4rem 0 2.2rem}
footer .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}

.f-brand svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--accent)}

/* ---------------- Clipboard / download / print ---------------- */
async function copyText(text, label){
  try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
  catch(e){
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.opacity='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
    catch(e2){ toast('Copy failed — select the text manually'); }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}
function downloadText(filename, text){
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url; a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 400);
  toast('Downloading ' + filename);
}
function printHtml(title, html){
  const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=840,height=1000');
  if(!w){ toast('Pop-up blocked — allow pop-ups to print'); return; }
  w.document.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>'+title+'</title><style>'+
    'body{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#111;margin:2rem auto;max-width:760px;line-height:1.6;font-size:12pt}'+
    'h1{font-size:19pt;margin:0 0 14px}h2{font-size:9.5pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#0c6b4d;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;padding-bottom:3px;margin:16px 0 8px}'+
    'p{margin:5px 0}ul{margin:5px 0 8px;padding-left:18px}li{margin:3px 0}@media print{body{margin:0}}'+
    '</style></head><body>'+html+'</body></html>');
  w.document.close();
  setTimeout(() => { try{ w.focus(); w.print(); }catch(e){} }, 350);
}

/* ---------------- Text helpers ---------------- */
function wordsOf(t){ const s=(t||'').trim(); return s ? s.split(/\s+/).length : 0; }
function fmt(n){ return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function escHtml(s){ return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>'); }

/* Minimal plain-text → HTML for the "paper" views */
function plainToHtml(text){
  const lines = escHtml(text||'').split('\n');
  let html = '', inList = false;
  const closeList = () => { if(inList){ html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const line = raw.trimEnd();
    const t = line.trim();
    if(!t){ closeList(); continue; }
    if(/^#{1,2}\s+/.test(t)){ closeList(); const lvl = t.startsWith('##') ? 2 : 1; html += '<h'+lvl+'>'+t.replace(/^#{1,2}\s+/,'')+'</h'+lvl+'>'; }
    else if(/^[-*•]\s+/.test(t)){ if(!inList){ html += '<ul>'; inList = true; } html += '<li>'+t.replace(/^[-*•]\s+/,'')+'</li>'; }
    else { closeList(); html += '<p>'+t+'</p>'; }
  }
  closeList();
  return html;
}

/* ---------------- Section parsing ---------------- */
function parseSections(full){
  const lines = (full||'').split('\n');
  let cover = -1, qa = -1;
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    if(!t) continue;
    const isCover = /\bcover letter\b/i.test(t) && t.length < 90 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    const isQa = /\binterview\b/i.test(t) && /\bquestion/i.test(t) && t.length < 100 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    if(cover < 0 && isCover){ cover = i; continue; }
    if(cover >= 0 && qa < 0 && isQa){ qa = i; break; }
  }
  if(cover < 0) cover = lines.length;
  if(qa < 0 || qa <= cover) qa = lines.length;
  const clean = s => s.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  return {
    resume: clean(lines.slice(0, cover).join('\n')),
    cover: clean(lines.slice(cover+1, qa).join('\n')),
    qa: clean(lines.slice(qa+1).join('\n'))
  };
}
function parseQa(text){
  const items = [];
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n');
  let cur = null;
  const flush = () => { if(cur){ items.push(cur); cur = null; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const t = raw.trim();
    const m = t.match(/^(?:Q\s*\d+\s*[:.)\-]?\s*|\d{1,2}\s*[.):\-]\s+|Question\s*\d+\s*:?\s+)(.*)$/i);
    if(m && m[1].length > 2){ flush(); cur = { q:m[1].trim(), a:'' }; continue; }
    if(/^(?:answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t) && !cur){ continue; }
    if(!cur){
      if(t.length < 130 && !/[.!?]$/.test(t) && (/\?$/.test(t) || /^(?:what|why|how|where|when|tell|describe|give|explain|walk|what's)/i.test(t))){
        cur = { q:t, a:'' };
      } else continue;
    } else if(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t)){
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t.replace(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]\s*/i,'');
    } else {
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t;
    }
  }
  flush();
  return items.map(x => ({ q:x.q, a:x.a.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() }));
}
function paperTitle(text){
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
  for(const l of lines){
    if(l.length < 4 || l.length > 45) continue;
    if(/^https?:|^mailto:|\+?[\d\s().-]{9,}$/.test(l)) continue;
    if(/[^A-Za-z .'-]/.test(l)) continue;
    const words = l.split(/\s+/);
    if(words.length < 2 || words.length > 5) continue;
    if(!words[0][0] || /[a-z]/.test(words[0][0])) continue;
    return l;
  }
  return 'Resume';
}

/* ---------------- Streaming ---------------- */
function pushChunk(text){
  liveFull += text;
  if(liveTimer) return;
  liveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    liveTimer = null;
    renderOutput(parseSections(liveFull), { caret:true });
  }, 150);
}
function stopLive(){ if(liveTimer){ clearTimeout(liveTimer); liveTimer = null; } }

function readStream(reader, push, onErr, onDone){
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  return (async () => {
    while(true){
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if(done) break;
      buf += dec.decode(value, { stream:true });
      let nl;
      while((nl = buf.indexOf('\n')) !== -1){
        const line = buf.slice(0, nl).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
        buf = buf.slice(nl + 1);
        if(!line || !line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
        const data = line.slice(5).trim();
        if(data === '[DONE]') return onDone(true);
        try{
          const j = JSON.parse(data);
          const d = j.choices && j.choices[0] && (j.choices[0].delta || j.choices[0].message);
          const t = d && (d.content != null ? d.content : (d && d.content_parts ? d.content_parts.join('') : null));
          if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
        }catch(e){ /* partial line — ignore */ }
      }
    }
    onDone(false);
  })();
}
function nonStream(json, push){
  const c = json.choices && json.choices[0] && json.choices[0].message;
  const t = c && c.content;
  if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
}

async function callModel(prompt, signal){
  const url = (settings.endpoint || '').trim();
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method:'POST',
    signal,
    headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'Authorization':'Bearer ' + (settings.key || '') },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: settings.model || 'Local model',
      stream: true,
      temperature: settings.temp,
      max_tokens: Math.max(256, Math.floor((settings.ctx || 65536) * 0.7)),
      messages: [{ role:'user', content: prompt }]
    })
  });
  if(!res.ok){
    let msg = 'HTTP ' + res.status;
    try{ const j = await res.json(); msg = (j.error && j.error.message) || j.error || j.message || msg; if(typeof msg !== 'string') msg = JSON.stringify(msg); }catch(e){}
    throw new Error(msg + ' — ' + url);
  }
  const ctype = (res.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
  if(ctype.indexOf('json') !== -1){
    const json = await res.json();
    nonStream(json, pushChunk);
    return;
  }
  await readStream(res.body.getReader(), pushChunk, null, () => {});
}

async function generate(){
  const prompt = buildPrompt();
  if(!elResume.value.trim() || !elJob.value.trim()) return;
  running = true; liveFull = ''; lastSections = {resume:'',cover:'',qa:''};
  btnGenerate.disabled = true; btnStop.classList.add('show');
  abortCtrl = new AbortController();
  setStatus('run', 'Generating — streaming from ' + (settings.model || 'Local model') + '…');
  renderOutput({resume:'',cover:'',qa:''}, { caret:true });
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try{
    await callModel(prompt, abortCtrl.signal);
    stopLive();
    const secs = ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1);
    const s = parseSections(liveFull);
    lastSections = s;
    if(!liveFull.trim()){
      setStatus('err', 'The model returned an empty response.');
    } else {
      setStatus('ok', 'Done in ' + secs + 's · ' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' characters · ' + (currentQa.length || 30) + ' Q&As detected');
      renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
    }
  }catch(err){
    stopLive();
    const aborted = (err && err.name === 'AbortError');
    if(aborted){
      const s = parseSections(liveFull);
      lastSections = s;
      if(liveFull.trim()){
        renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
        setStatus('ok', 'Stopped by you — partial output kept (' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' chars).');
      } else {
        resetOutput();
        setStatus('', 'Stopped before anything was generated.');
      }
    } else {
      resetOutput();
      let msg = (err && err.message) || 'Request failed';
      if(/failed to fetch|networkerror|load failed|fetch/i.test(msg)){
        msg = 'Could not reach ' + (settings.endpoint||'the endpoint') + '. Is the server running? Check the endpoint, API key and model in Settings — and the browser console for CORS details.';
      }
      setStatus('err', msg);
    }
  }finally{
    running = false; abortCtrl = null;
    btnStop.classList.remove('show');
    refreshCounters();
  }
}

btnGenerate.addEventListener('click', generate);
btnStop.addEventListener('click', () => { if(abortCtrl) abortCtrl.abort(); });

/* ---------------- Init ---------------- */
(function init(){
  const draft = loadDraft();
  elResume.value = draft ? (draft.r != null ? draft.r : SAMPLE_RESUME) : SAMPLE_RESUME;
  elJob.value = draft ? (draft.j != null ? draft.j : '') : '';
  refreshSettingsUI();
  resetOutput();
  refreshCounters();
})();
</script>

@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(94,224,176,.45)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(94,224,176,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(94,224,176,0)}}

/* ---------- Results ---------- */
.results{margin:1.6rem 0 2.6rem}

/* ---------- Paper (resume / cover letter) ---------- */
.paper{
  background:var(--paper);
  color:#242b36;
  border:1px solid var(--paper-line);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.6rem);

.qa-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}

/* ---------------- Clipboard / download / print ---------------- */
async function copyText(text, label){
  try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
  catch(e){
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.opacity='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try{ document.execCommand('copy'); toast(label || 'Copied to clipboard'); }
    catch(e2){ toast('Copy failed — select the text manually'); }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}
function downloadText(filename, text){
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url; a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 400);
  toast('Downloading ' + filename);
}
function printHtml(title, html){
  const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=840,height=1000');
  if(!w){ toast('Pop-up blocked — allow pop-ups to print'); return; }
  w.document.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>'+title+'</title><style>'+
    'body{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#111;margin:2rem auto;max-width:760px;line-height:1.6;font-size:12pt}'+
    'h1{font-size:19pt;margin:0 0 14px}h2{font-size:9.5pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#0c6b4d;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;padding-bottom:3px;margin:16px 0 8px}'+
    'p{margin:5px 0}ul{margin:5px 0 8px;padding-left:18px}li{margin:3px 0}@media print{body{margin:0}}'+
    '</style></head><body>'+html+'</body></html>');
  w.document.close();
  setTimeout(() => { try{ w.focus(); w.print(); }catch(e){} }, 350);
}

/* ---------------- Text helpers ---------------- */
function wordsOf(t){ const s=(t||'').trim(); return s ? s.split(/\s+/).length : 0; }
function fmt(n){ return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function escHtml(s){ return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>'); }

/* Minimal plain-text → HTML for the "paper" views */
function plainToHtml(text){
  const lines = escHtml(text||'').split('\n');
  let html = '', inList = false;
  const closeList = () => { if(inList){ html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const line = raw.trimEnd();
    const t = line.trim();
    if(!t){ closeList(); continue; }
    if(/^#{1,2}\s+/.test(t)){ closeList(); const lvl = t.startsWith('##') ? 2 : 1; html += '<h'+lvl+'>'+t.replace(/^#{1,2}\s+/,'')+'</h'+lvl+'>'; }
    else if(/^[-*•]\s+/.test(t)){ if(!inList){ html += '<ul>'; inList = true; } html += '<li>'+t.replace(/^[-*•]\s+/,'')+'</li>'; }
    else { closeList(); html += '<p>'+t+'</p>'; }
  }
  closeList();
  return html;
}

/* ---------------- Prompt building ---------------- */

/* ---------------- Status ---------------- */
function setStatus(mode, msg){
  statusEl.className = 'status' + (mode ? ' ' + mode : '');
  statusEl.querySelector('.smsg').textContent = msg || '';
}

/* ---------------- Section parsing ---------------- */
function parseSections(full){
  const lines = (full||'').split('\n');
  let cover = -1, qa = -1;
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    if(!t) continue;
    const isCover = /\bcover letter\b/i.test(t) && t.length < 90 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    const isQa = /\binterview\b/i.test(t) && /\bquestion/i.test(t) && t.length < 100 && !/^(?:[-*•]|\d)/.test(t);
    if(cover < 0 && isCover){ cover = i; continue; }
    if(cover >= 0 && qa < 0 && isQa){ qa = i; break; }
  }
  if(cover < 0) cover = lines.length;
  if(qa < 0 || qa <= cover) qa = lines.length;
  const clean = s => s.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  return {
    resume: clean(lines.slice(0, cover).join('\n')),
    cover: clean(lines.slice(cover+1, qa).join('\n')),
    qa: clean(lines.slice(qa+1).join('\n'))
  };
}
function parseQa(text){
  const items = [];
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n');
  let cur = null;
  const flush = () => { if(cur){ items.push(cur); cur = null; } };
  for(const raw of lines){
    const t = raw.trim();
    const m = t.match(/^(?:Q\s*\d+\s*[:.)\-]?\s*|\d{1,2}\s*[.):\-]\s+|Question\s*\d+\s*:?\s+)(.*)$/i);
    if(m && m[1].length > 2){ flush(); cur = { q:m[1].trim(), a:'' }; continue; }
    if(/^(?:answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t) && !cur){ continue; }
    if(!cur){
      if(t.length < 130 && !/[.!?]$/.test(t) && (/\?$/.test(t) || /^(?:what|why|how|where|when|tell|describe|give|explain|walk|what's)/i.test(t))){
        cur = { q:t, a:'' };
      } else continue;
    } else if(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]/i.test(t)){
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t.replace(/^(?:a\.?|answer|suggested answer|potential answer|response)\s*[:.)\-]\s*/i,'');
    } else {
      cur.a += (cur.a ? '\n' : '') + t;
    }
  }
  flush();
  return items.map(x => ({ q:x.q, a:x.a.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() }));
}
function paperTitle(text){
  const lines = (text||'').split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
  for(const l of lines){
    if(l.length < 4 || l.length > 45) continue;
    if(/^https?:|^mailto:|\+?[\d\s().-]{9,}$/.test(l)) continue;
    if(/[^A-Za-z .'-]/.test(l)) continue;
    const words = l.split(/\s+/);
    if(words.length < 2 || words.length > 5) continue;
    if(!words[0][0] || /[a-z]/.test(words[0][0])) continue;
    return l;
  }
  return 'Resume';
}

/* ---------------- Output rendering ---------------- */
const EMPTY_HTML = (icon, title, sub) =>
  '<div class="empty"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+icon+'</svg>'+
  '<div class="et">'+title+'</div><div class="es">'+sub+'</div></div>';
const ICON_DOC = '<path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6M9 13h6M9 17h6"/>';
const ICON_MAIL = '<rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="m2 7 10 6 10-6"/>';
const ICON_QA = '<path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>';

function renderOutput(sections, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const caret = opts.caret ? '<span class="stream-caret"></span>' : '';
  /* resume */
  $('#outResume').innerHTML = sections.resume
    ? '<div class="paper"><h1>'+escHtml(paperTitle(sections.resume))+'</h1>'+plainToHtml(sections.resume)+caret+'</div>'
    : EMPTY_HTML(ICON_DOC, 'Your tailored resume appears here', 'Fill in the resume and job description, then hit Generate.');
  /* cover letter */
  $('#outLetter').innerHTML = sections.cover
    ? '<div class="paper"><h1>Cover Letter</h1>'+plainToHtml(sections.cover)+caret+'</div>'
    : EMPTY_HTML(ICON_MAIL, 'Cover letter appears here', 'It is drafted to match the resume and the role.');
  /* q&a */
  currentQa = parseQa(sections.qa);
  if(sections.qa && currentQa.length){
    $('#outQa').innerHTML = '<div class="qa-list">' + currentQa.map((it, i) =>
      '<div class="qa'+(opts.firstOpen ? ' open' : '')+'" data-i="'+i+'">'+
      '<button class="qa-q" type="button" aria-expanded="'+(i===0 && opts.firstOpen)+'">'+
      '<span class="qnum">'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="qt">'+escHtml(it.q)+'</span>'+
      '<svg class="qchev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>'+
      '</button><div class="qa-a"><div class="qa-a-in"><div class="qa-body">'+escHtml(it.a || '—')+'</div></div></div></div>'
    ).join('') + '</div>';
  } else if(sections.qa){
    $('#outQa').innerHTML = '<div class="paper" style="max-width:860px">'+plainToHtml(sections.qa)+caret+'</div>';
  } else {
    $('#outQa').innerHTML = EMPTY_HTML(ICON_QA, '30 interview Q&As appear here', 'Questions and potential answers for the role.');
  }
  /* counters + action availability */
  $('#cntResume').textContent = fmt(wordsOf(sections.resume)) + 'w';
  $('#cntLetter').textContent = fmt(wordsOf(sections.cover)) + 'w';
  $('#cntQa').textContent = sections.qa ? currentQa.length : 0;
  $('#pwResume').textContent = sections.resume ? fmt(wordsOf(sections.resume)) + ' words' : '';
  $('#pwLetter').textContent = sections.cover ? fmt(wordsOf(sections.cover)) + ' words' : '';
  $('#pwQa').textContent = sections.qa ? (currentQa.length + (currentQa.length===1?' question':' questions') + ' · click to expand') : '';
  const has = { r:!!sections.resume, c:!!sections.cover, q:!!sections.qa };
  ['#btnCopyResumeOut','#btnDownloadResume','#btnPrintResume'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.r);
  ['#btnCopyLetter','#btnDownloadLetter','#btnPrintLetter'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.c);
  ['#btnCopyQa','#btnDownloadQa'].forEach(s => $(s).disabled = !has.q);
  if(opts.caret) switchTab('paneResume');
}
function resetOutput(){
  renderOutput({resume:'',cover:'',qa:''});
}

/* ---------------- Tabs ---------------- */
function switchTab(paneId){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.pane === paneId));
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === paneId));
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(t.dataset.pane)));
$('#outQa').addEventListener('click', e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.qa-q');
  if(!btn) return;
  const item = btn.parentElement;
  const open = item.classList.toggle('open');

});

/* ---------------- Output action buttons ---------------- */
let lastSections = { resume:'', cover:'', qa:'' };
$('#btnCopyResumeOut').addEventListener('click', () => copyText(lastSections.resume, 'Resume copied'));
$('#btnCopyLetter').addEventListener('click', () => copyText(lastSections.cover, 'Cover letter copied'));

$('#btnPrintLetter').addEventListener('click', () => printHtml('Cover Letter', '<h1>Cover Letter</h1>' + plainToHtml(lastSections.cover)));

/* ---------------- Streaming ---------------- */
function pushChunk(text){
  liveFull += text;
  if(liveTimer) return;
  liveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    liveTimer = null;
    renderOutput(parseSections(liveFull), { caret:true });
  }, 150);
}
function stopLive(){ if(liveTimer){ clearTimeout(liveTimer); liveTimer = null; } }

function readStream(reader, push, onErr, onDone){
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  return (async () => {
    while(true){
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if(done) break;
      buf += dec.decode(value, { stream:true });
      let nl;
      while((nl = buf.indexOf('\n')) !== -1){
        const line = buf.slice(0, nl).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
        buf = buf.slice(nl + 1);
        if(!line || !line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
        const data = line.slice(5).trim();
        if(data === '[DONE]') return onDone(true);
        try{
          const j = JSON.parse(data);
          const d = j.choices && j.choices[0] && (j.choices[0].delta || j.choices[0].message);
          const t = d && (d.content != null ? d.content : (d && d.content_parts ? d.content_parts.join('') : null));
          if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
        }catch(e){ /* partial line — ignore */ }
      }
    }
    onDone(false);
  })();
}
function nonStream(json, push){
  const c = json.choices && json.choices[0] && json.choices[0].message;
  const t = c && c.content;
  if(typeof t === 'string' && t) push(t);
}

async function callModel(prompt, signal){
  const url = (settings.endpoint || '').trim();
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method:'POST',
    signal,
    headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'Authorization':'Bearer ' + (settings.key || '') },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: settings.model || 'Local model',
      stream: true,
      temperature: settings.temp,
      max_tokens: Math.max(256, Math.floor((settings.ctx || 65536) * 0.7)),
      messages: [{ role:'user', content: prompt }]
    })
  });
  if(!res.ok){
    let msg = 'HTTP ' + res.status;
    try{ const j = await res.json(); msg = (j.error && j.error.message) || j.error || j.message || msg; if(typeof msg !== 'string') msg = JSON.stringify(msg); }catch(e){}
    throw new Error(msg + ' — ' + url);
  }
  const ctype = (res.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
  if(ctype.indexOf('json') !== -1){
    const json = await res.json();
    nonStream(json, pushChunk);
    return;
  }
  await readStream(res.body.getReader(), pushChunk, null, () => {});
}

async function generate(){
  const prompt = buildPrompt();
  if(!elResume.value.trim() || !elJob.value.trim()) return;
  running = true; liveFull = ''; lastSections = {resume:'',cover:'',qa:''};
  btnGenerate.disabled = true; btnStop.classList.add('show');
  abortCtrl = new AbortController();
  setStatus('run', 'Generating — streaming from ' + (settings.model || 'Local model') + '…');
  renderOutput({resume:'',cover:'',qa:''}, { caret:true });
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try{
    await callModel(prompt, abortCtrl.signal);
    stopLive();
    const secs = ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1);
    const s = parseSections(liveFull);
    lastSections = s;
    if(!liveFull.trim()){
      setStatus('err', 'The model returned an empty response.');
    } else {
      setStatus('ok', 'Done in ' + secs + 's · ' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' characters · ' + (currentQa.length || 30) + ' Q&As detected');
      renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
    }
  }catch(err){
    stopLive();
    const aborted = (err && err.name === 'AbortError');
    if(aborted){
      const s = parseSections(liveFull);
      lastSections = s;
      if(liveFull.trim()){
        renderOutput(s, { firstOpen:true });
        setStatus('ok', 'Stopped by you — partial output kept (' + fmt(liveFull.length) + ' chars).');
      } else {
        resetOutput();
        setStatus('', 'Stopped before anything was generated.');
      }
    } else {
      resetOutput();
      let msg = (err && err.message) || 'Request failed';
      if(/failed to fetch|networkerror|load failed|fetch/i.test(msg)){
        msg = 'Could not reach ' + (settings.endpoint||'the endpoint') + '. Is the server running? Check the endpoint, API key and model in Settings — and the browser console for CORS details.';
      }
      setStatus('err', msg);
    }
  }finally{
    running = false; abortCtrl = null;
    btnStop.classList.remove('show');
    refreshCounters();
  }
}

btnGenerate.addEventListener('click', generate);
btnStop.addEventListener('click', () => { if(abortCtrl) abortCtrl.abort(); });

/* ---------------- Init ---------------- */
(function init(){
  const draft = loadDraft();
  elResume.value = draft ? (draft.r != null ? draft.r : SAMPLE_RESUME) : SAMPLE_RESUME;
  elJob.value = draft ? (draft.j != null ? draft.j : '') : '';
  refreshSettingsUI();
  resetOutput();
  refreshCounters();
})();
</script>
